runners_data.name: Ka Mate Du Brivet
runners_data.note: Only natural pace-setter but limited recent evidence suggests stamina questions at this extended trip

runners_data.name: Broomfield Aderra
runners_data.note: In-form runner with solid recent win on similar going who should get ideal tracking position behind the leader

runners_data.name: Willshebe Court
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with question marks over recent form but could benefit if others go too fast too early

races.paceDynamic: Ka Mate Du Brivet will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the start as the only confirmed front-runner in a small field. With Broomfield Aderra likely to sit handy but not apply early pressure, and Willshebe Court dropping in behind, Ka Mate Du Brivet can dictate a comfortable rhythm through the early stages before the pace inevitably quickens from three out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ka Mate Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Ka Mate Du Brivet jumps cleanly and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The leader sets sustainable fractions without pressure and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges. Broomfield Aderra and Willshebe Court both come with their runs but cannot peg back the pacesetter who has controlled the race from start to finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Aderra Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Broomfield Aderra travels strongly in second and Ka Mate Du Brivet weakens
scenarios.body: The recent winner sits perfectly in behind the pace and moves smoothly into contention turning for home. Ka Mate Du Brivet's early exertions tell in the final half-mile as Broomfield Aderra's superior recent form shows.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Willshebe Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too strong and the front two come back to the closer
scenarios.body: Ka Mate Du Brivet and Broomfield Aderra engage too early in the straight after a searching pace. Willshebe Court, who has been patiently ridden throughout, finds a turn of foot that the pace-exposed leaders cannot match in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Ka Mate Du Brivet makes jumping errors and the race becomes messy
scenarios.body: The leader's mistakes disrupt the rhythm and create a stop-start affair that suits none of the runners ideally. The race becomes a battle of attrition rather than class, with whoever stays on their feet longest prevailing in a tight finish.

watchPoints.text: Ka Mate Du Brivet's jumping under pressure - any significant errors will hand initiative to Broomfield Aderra
Broomfield Aderra's position early - if too keen or too far back the race dynamic changes completely
Willshebe Court's early enthusiasm - any signs of pulling hard would compromise hold-up tactics
The pace through the middle mile - if Ka Mate Du Brivet goes too fast it opens door for closers
Ground conditions on the day - any softening would particularly suit Broomfield Aderra's recent form profile

runners_data.name: Peking Opera

runners_data.name: Wot You Wearing

runners_data.name: Vendant

runners_data.name: Kylenoe Dancer

races.paceDynamic: Motazzen will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, given his clear preference for leading and lack of other committed front-runners. Peking Opera, Vendant and Kylenoe Dancer may press forward early but are more likely to settle prominently rather than challenge Motazzen's lead directly. This creates a potentially tactical affair where the hold-up horses Geordies Betty, Godot and Wot You Wearing can be delivered late if the pace becomes crawling.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Motazzen Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Motazzen dictates a moderate pace without serious early pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The leader builds a decisive advantage turning for home while the hold-up horses struggle to close from too far back. Motazzen's superior strike rate on good ground and front-running ability proves decisive in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the field bunches up approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the fresher hold-up horses can unleash their kicks. Geordies Betty's recent good form and closing style proves most effective when delivered with a perfectly-timed challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Peking Opera and Vendant press Motazzen early enough to ensure a genuine gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and favors those who can travel strongly in the leading group. Vendant's recent runner-up effort and prominent style gives him the edge over his similarly-positioned rivals in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race unfolds chaotically with multiple pace collapses or interference at crucial stages
scenarios.body: The disrupted rhythm suits a horse who can adapt quickly to changing circumstances. Kylenoe Dancer's recent win and ability to race prominently while finishing strongly makes him best-placed to capitalize on any confusion.

watchPoints.text: Motazzen's jumping under pressure - if he makes any significant errors while being challenged, his front-running advantage disappears completely.
Early positioning of Peking Opera and Vendant - if both press Motazzen simultaneously, they could create the strong gallop that favors the closers.
Geordies Betty's position turning for home - she needs to be within striking distance as her closing kick is her main weapon.
Godot's jumping rhythm - his hold-up style requires confident jumping to maintain position for his late challenge.
The pace through the first mile - if Motazzen is allowed to crawl early, the hold-up horses face an impossible task from too far back.

scenarios.trigger: If Ronnies Reflection gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
